''See also: [[Elderspawn Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Elderspawn are diverse, alien entities that serve as the agents or servants of the [[Great Elders]]. They vary significantly in biology and intelligence, ranging from animalistic creatures with little intellect to highly intelligent, ancient beings like [[Handmaidens]]. Their physical forms are incredibly varied and often appear as if they were assembled haphazardly; examples include ten-legged arachnid [[Inquisitors]], [[giant worms]], Shadow{{!}}shadow-men, amphibious hordes, flatworms with crocodile-like jaws, and octopus-like creatures with smooth heads. Some possess multiple eyes on stalks, while others have gills or wings. Their [[blood]] is typically described as purple, and their death cries are noted for being unsettlingly unique. In terms of behavior, Elderspawn can be unpredictable. While some are viewed as mindless monsters or parasites that feed on human emotions like vengeance, others act with precise coordination and intelligence, suggesting they are guided by a higher power. They can be malicious and soul-devouring, yet some are simply strange or alien without being inherently hostile. They often exist in a state of long-term slumber, waking only when disturbed or when they perceive an existential threat. Some individuals have even formed tenuous, long-term relationships with humans, though they are often perceived as plotting something insidious. They are capable of immense [[destruction]], such as tearing open prisons or causing entire islands to shake, and they serve various purposes ranging from learning to direct combat.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|These [[giant]], clawed creatures exhibit highly varied and alien biology, ranging from lime-green beings with six yellow eyes and webbed feet to dark blue or purple chitinous forms. Some variations feature ten spear-sharp spider-legs, while others possess dark green skin, small wings, tentacles over their mouths, or eyes on stalks positioned on their backs. They can also manifest as fanged fish with stubby limbs, [[giant]] flatworms with crocodile teeth, or even entities lacking heads, hearts, spines, or limbs.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Elderspawn possess an awareness that can be read, though doing so may cause madness. While some are described as having a hive mind or animal-like intelligence, others can command others and act as messengers for the [[Sleepless]]. They are often characterized by a state of malice and burning frustration, though they may also be strange or alien in mentality without being necessarily malicious.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|These entities can be summoned through the application of [[Intent]] and serve as guides for Navigators crossing the [[Aion]]. They are capable of imitating human voices, borrowing faces, and communicating as messengers for the [[Sleepless]] [[cabal]]. Additionally, some Elderspawn have developed the ability to command others.}}

== History ==
=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|General characteristics}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|An Elderspawn is a clawed creature that [[Calder]] was forced to nail to the interior of his hull.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c1">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 1</ref> These entities do not experience tiredness in the same way that humans do.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c3">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 3</ref> The term also serves as a measure for volume and loudness.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c7">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 7</ref> Furthermore, the Elderspawn possesses an awareness that [[Calder]] is able to read.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c7" />}}

<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|An [[Elderspawn]] is a clawed creature that [[Calder]] had to nail to the inside of his hull.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c1" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|[[Elderspawn]] are creatures that may not get tired in the human sense.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c3" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|The volume of [[Elderspawn]] is a measure for loudness.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c7" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|The [[Elderspawn]] is an entity with awareness that can be read by [[Calder]].<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c7" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|Navigators and the Aion}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|These [[giant]] creatures serve as guides for Navigators attempting to cross the [[Aion]], though they are also known to attack the gates as monsters.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c9">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 9</ref><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c12">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c18">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 18</ref> While their biology and mentality can be strange or alien, they are not always malicious, even though some individuals may develop the ability to command others.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c11">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 11</ref><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c19">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 19</ref> The physical forms of these beings vary, as some lack limbs, spines, hearts, or heads.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c10">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 10</ref> They can bother ships unless an Elder is chained to them, and they become immobilized upon contact with [[Awakened iron]].<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c12" /><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c19" /> Sleepless{{!}}The Sleepless might even dispatch a killer to eliminate a witness of an Elderspawn, and the ruler of The Empire{{!}}the Empire has been described as an Elderspawned excuse for a leader.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c9" /><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c15">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 15</ref>}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Elderspawn]] include [[Shuffles]], who have little intelligence more than animals.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c23" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Elderspawn]] are hordes that can kneel.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c23" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|Battles and meetings}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|When Elderspawn die, they produce floating green lights, and an army of them was once swept from the shores by [[Kerian]] through the collapsing of the [[Veil]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c2">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 2</ref> Following a battle with these creatures, a group of girls managed to survive an encounter during a meeting with one.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c4">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 4</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c6">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 6</ref> While a fight remains possible, the Guard leader has identified Darius Allbright{{!}}Darius as an Elderspawn.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c7">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 7</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c8">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 8</ref> These beings created the bronze door found in the tunnel and are characterized by a shifting, skittering movement.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c9">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 9</ref> An Elderspawn possesses eyes on stalks located on its back and shows no concern for humans.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c9" /> More hideous than any [[Kameira]], these creatures possess sickening purple [[blood]] and emit death-screams that sound like a blend of a whistling teakettle and a screaming horse.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c16">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 16</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c18">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 18</ref> As they are currently being cleansed from the Capital, it is known that these beings have the ability to borrow a person's face.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c16" /><ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c19">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 19</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">14</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|The deaths of [[Elderspawn]] produce floating green lights.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c2" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Kerian]] swept an army of [[Elderspawn]] from the shores by collapsing the [[Veil]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c2" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|There was a battle with the [[Elderspawn]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c4" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|The girls survived a meeting with an [[Elderspawn]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c6" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|There is a possibility of a fight with [[Elderspawn]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c7" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|The Guard leader identifies Darius Allbright{{!}}Darius as an [[Elderspawn]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c8" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Elderspawn]] created the bronze door in the tunnel.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c9" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|An [[Elderspawn]] is a creature that moves with a shifting, skittering movement.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c9" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|The [[Elderspawn]] creature has eyes on stalks positioned on its back.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c9" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Elderspawn]] are creatures that do not care about humans.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c9" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Elderspawn]] have sickening purple [[blood]] and death-screams that sound like a blend of a screaming horse and a whistling teakettle.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c16" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Elderspawn]] are being cleansed from the Capital.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c16" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|An [[Elderspawn]] is a creature more hideous than any [[Kameira]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c18" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Elderspawn]] are beings that can borrow a person's face.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c19" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Messengers of the Sleepless}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Acting as messengers, the Elderspawn translate the voices of the [[Sleepless]] [[cabal]] and report their findings back to the leaders.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c5">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 5</ref> After [[Estyr]] identified an Elderspawn, it was noted that silver rings can be used to ward them off.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c6">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 6</ref><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c9">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 9</ref> These creatures may be encircling the tower, with [[giant]] fanged specimens spotted in the surf.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c10">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 10</ref><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c12">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 12</ref> The lime-green Elderspawn possess six yellow eyes, a dozen webbed amphibian feet, stingers, and the physiology of [[giant]] flatworms with extendible jaws and crocodile teeth.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c12" /><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c14">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 14</ref> Having affected the mind and body of [[Mister Goss]], these creations of [[Othaghor]] were also mentioned by [[Calder]] during his speech.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c14" /><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c15">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 15</ref><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c16">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 16</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">12</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Elderspawn]] messengers translate the voices of the [[Sleepless]] [[cabal]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c5" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Elderspawn]] report back to the [[Sleepless]] leaders.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c5" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Estyr]] identified something or someone as an [[Elderspawn]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c6" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Silver]] rings are used to ward off [[Elderspawn]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c9" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Elderspawn]] may be encircling the tower.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c10" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Giant fanged [[Elderspawn]] are in the surf.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c12" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Elderspawn]] are lime-green creatures with six yellow eyes and a dozen webbed amphibian feet.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c12" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Elderspawn]] have stingers.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c12" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Elderspawn]] are [[giant]] flatworms with extendible jaws and crocodile teeth.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c14" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Elderspawn]] have affected [[Mister Goss]]'s mind and body.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c14" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Calder]] mentions having seen [[Elderspawn]] in his speech.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c15" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Elderspawn]] are creations of [[Othaghor]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c16" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Capital and Pilgrims}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Due to the [[Awakening]] process, certain [[Pilgrims]] develop a holy zeal focused on eradicating the Elderspawn.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c17">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 17</ref> These creatures exist around the Capital and serve as servants to the [[Elders]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c20">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 20</ref> During her imprisonment, an Elderspawn assisted [[Jerri]] by disposing of waste and dragging food to her.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c19">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 19</ref> Because of their presence, ordinary citizens in the Capital invested in objects designed to protect them from these beings.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c21">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 21</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">5</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Some [[Pilgrims]] gain a holy zeal toward the eradication of [[Elderspawn]] due to the [[Awakening]] process.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c17" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Elderspawn]] served [[Jerri]] by dragging food and disposing of waste during her imprisonment.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c19" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Elderspawn]] are servants of [[Elders]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c20" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Elderspawn]] are creatures that exist around the Capital.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c20" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Ordinary people in the Capital invested objects to protect them from [[Elderspawn]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c21" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Aquatic Elderspawn}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|A mass of aquatic Elderspawn seethed beneath the [[water]]'s surface, appearing as fanged fish equipped with stubby arms and clawed legs.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c24">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 24</ref> The surrounding [[water]] grew dark with the presence of Elderspawn corpses, which [[Calder]] snapped as he marched forward.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c24" /> These entities were specifically designed to be countered by the [[Awakened sword]], even as pieces of Elderspawn and human corpses began stitching themselves together.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c25">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 25</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">6</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|A mass of aquatic [[Elderspawn]] seethed beneath the surface.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c24" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Elderspawn]] are fanged fish with clawed, stubby legs and arms.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c24" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[water]] was dark with [[Elderspawn]] corpses.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c24" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Calder]] snaps [[Elderspawn]] as he marches forward.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c24" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Elderspawn]] are entities that the [[Awakened sword]] was designed to be used against.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c25" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Pieces of [[Elderspawn]] and human corpses were stitching themselves together.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c25" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Emperor's death}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Certain Elderspawn function with a hive-like shared mind, and the name itself is used by [[Estyr]] as an expression of fury and hatred.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c5">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 5</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c6">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 6</ref> Following the Emperor's death, a global uprising of these creatures occurred, leading Darius Allbright{{!}}Allbright to suggest they be flushed out of the [[Imperial]] Palace.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c10">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 10</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c14">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 14</ref> While they are unable to pass through the Bastion's Veil{{!}}Bastion’s Veil mist, [[Loreli]]'s Beacon light has the power to torch them.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c13">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 13</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c18">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 18</ref> The [[Creeping Shadow]] influences the world by crafting Elderspawn, which have even driven out some Great Elder tombs{{!}}Elder tombs.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c20">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 20</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c22">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 22</ref> During encounters, Elderspawn have been seen pooling at [[Darius Allbright]]'s feet and clinging to walls, while armies of them appear in the distance.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c23">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 23</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 25</ref> They can be found in the [[water]] surrounding the Navigators and on their decks, with those made of flesh and bone capable of crawling up railings.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25" /><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c26">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 26</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">13</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Some [[Elderspawn]] share a mind like a hive.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c5" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Estyr]] uses the term '[[Elderspawn]]' as a declaration of hatred and fury.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c6" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Darius Allbright{{!}}Allbright suggests flushing out the [[Elderspawn]] from the [[Imperial]] Palace.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c10" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Elderspawn]] cannot pass through the Bastion's Veil{{!}}Bastion’s Veil mist.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c13" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|There was an uprising of [[Elderspawn]] around the world on the night of the Emperor’s death.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c14" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Loreli]]'s Beacon light torches [[Elderspawn]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c18" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Crafting [[Elderspawn]] is a way the [[Creeping Shadow]] can influence the world.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c20" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Some Great Elder tombs{{!}}Elder tombs were driven out by [[Elderspawn]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c22" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Elderspawn]] pooled around [[Darius Allbright]]'s feet and clung to walls.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c23" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|An army of [[Elderspawn]] was seen in the distance.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Elderspawn]] are in the [[water]] around the Navigators.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Elderspawn]] were on the deck.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Elderspawn]] of flesh and bone can crawl up railings.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c26" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|In volume no less than the Elderspawn, he announced, “Danger! All hands on deck!<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c7" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|So-called “street gangs” had been the darlings of the newssheets for five years, haunting the poorer quarters like roving bands of Elderspawn.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c4" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|“Sweeps all lesser Elderspawn off the Island.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c26" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|“Elderspawn! Seize him for questioning!”<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c8" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|“I had a run-in with some Elderspawn a few years back. As I was so handsome, one of them borrowed my face, and he has yet to give it back.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c19" />}}
